summary: @servicetitan/standalone-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json, so `setup.mjs` runs automatically on every `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (opaque `_0x` identifiers and wrapper objects); it checks for a local `bun` binary, and if absent downloads a Bun release archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<...>.zip`, extracts the `bun` executable, chmod +x's it, and invokes `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle heavily obfuscated with the obfuscator.io string-array rotation pattern (a ~1000-entry mixed constant array shifted by a rotator function, opaque identifiers) and is not referenced by the package's advertised entry `dist/index.js` — it exists only to be executed under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime at install time. The package presents itself as `@servicetitan/standalone-ui` "Shared components and utils for Standalone" and does ship legitimate-looking React sources under `src/` and `dist/`, but `author` is empty and the Bun-runtime dropper is unrelated to a React component library. Installing this package causes an obfuscated bundle to be fetched-adjacent and executed under an alternate language runtime chosen to bypass Node-based introspection, on every developer and CI machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
